record.title: Chinshwehaw commercial post closure until March 2024 reopening permission; trade routes remained blocked
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.endpoint_type: Formal post reopening; actual cargo resumption unverified
record.scope: Chinshwehaw border trade post opposite China.
record.direction: Cross-border commercial trade; direction-specific completeness unproved.
record.movement: Commercial goods handled by the Chinshwehaw post.
record.exceptions: Passenger, humanitarian and informal movement not established.
record.imposing_authority: MNDAA seized and controlled the post; merchant account does not identify every blocking authority.
record.enforcement: AFP reported the post closed for business; an RFA merchant described goods turned back at the gate.
record.consequences: Goods stranded on the Myanmar side.
record.relationship: Promotes Chinshwehaw component of R4-EA-L006. March reopening separates this phase from EA012 restrictions beginning July 2024; Muse remains a residual lead.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in the cited reports; no present status inferred.
record.official_rationale: MNDAA spokesperson attributed inability to restart trade to wartime insecurity; no separate initial gate-closure decree recovered.
record.context: The October offensive displaced junta control. Subsequent negotiations preceded resumption.
record.uncertainty: March 11 reopening concerns the post's availability and office operations. Contemporary March 15 merchant reporting says trade still did not flow because of the Lashio route blockade. Exact first cargo resumption is unverified; October gate-onset bounds remain.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. October 2023 to reported 11 March 2024 commercial resumption; exact elapsed duration unknown.
